parole.motivo_incerta: Of uncertain origin; Possibly; perhaps; modello unc/uncertain
parole.testo: From Old Galician-Portuguese carvalho of uncertain origin. Possibly from a local Latin *carbālius via Paleo-Hispanic, perhaps ultimately of Iberian origin. Cognate to Asturian carbayu, carba, Galician carballo, carba, and Spanish carvajo.
